name: anubis-monorepo
description: Monorepo root for the Anubis framework.

scripts.dev: yarn dev:env && docker compose --env-file .env -f starter/compose.yaml up -d --wait && dotenv -- concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "cargo run -p anubis-starter" "yarn workspace anubis-starter-frontend dev"
scripts.e2e: yarn dev:env && docker compose --env-file .env -f starter/compose.yaml up -d --wait && dotenv -v RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED=true -- concurrently --kill-others --success command-e2e -n api,web,e2e -c blue,green,magenta "cargo run -p anubis-starter" "yarn workspace anubis-starter-frontend dev" "yarn workspace anubis-starter-frontend test:e2e"
